This is the second iteration of my DIY CAD mouse, rebuilt from the ground up to behave like a real 6DoF controller this time. It uses a custom PCB with three magnetic sensors, a 3D printed spring, and a redesigned enclosure that’s smaller and easier to build. In this video I’ll show you the whole process from design and prototyping to assembly, testing, and comparing it to a real SpaceMouse.
